pattern: 恐れがある（おそれがある）
keywords: V dictionary / Nの + 恐れがある
Strong winds may cause the sign to fall.
At this rate, there is a risk of a water shortage.
With old equipment, there is a risk of losing data.
formation: V dictionary / Nの + 恐れがある
restrictions: Normally concerns a negative outcome, not a welcome possibility.
mistake: Use 可能性がある for a neutral or positive possibility.

segments.role: Warn of an undesirable possibility. V dictionary / Nの + 恐れがある
